data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":{"adopted_commitment_refs":[],"disanalogies":["Database Write-Ahead Logs use explicit checkpoint records, whereas token-budget exhaustion leaves implicit unframed fragments.","Database recovery explicitly replays and re-applies transactions, whereas reasoning resumption simply matches fingerprints and skips non-events."],"overturn_conditions":["If event framing is proven non-deterministic even with checksums, the quarantine mechanism fails and resumption must be refused.","If causal fingerprints are found to be computationally indistinguishable for divergent event streams, logical continuity verification fails."],"shared_structure":["Two-level decomposition of integrity into physical append-only integrity and logical causal continuity.","Quarantine of incomplete records to preserve causal identity without violating append-only semantics."],"source_memory_refs":["SRC_001","SRC_002"],"transfer_claims":["The quarantine mechanism for partial logs in physical systems applies directly to reasoning event streams: partial data is skipped without violating integrity.","Causal fingerprint matching from distributed systems applies to logical causal continuity verification in reasoning runs."]},"claim":"Resumption is safely permitted when the causal fingerprint of the recovered complete-event stream aligns with the uninterrupted stream, skipping any trailing partial bytes as non-events; resumption must be refused if the event framing protocol lacks deterministic delimiters to distinguish partial bytes from committed events.","counterconditions":[{"case":"The event framing protocol relies solely on length-prefixing without integrity checks or end-markers, making the quarantine of partial bytes non-deterministic.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The resumption protocol attempts to re-evaluate or garbage-collect the trailing partial bytes, treating them as committed events and violating append-only integrity.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"A causal fingerprint cannot be computed or matched due to insufficient protocol state, preventing verification of logical causal continuity.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Token-budget exhaustion may leave partial bytes at the end of the log. Under a self-delimiting framing protocol, these bytes lack event identity and are simply ignored by the resumption protocol. Physical append-only integrity (SCR_006) is preserved because no committed event is modified or deleted. Logical causal continuity (SCR_007) is verified by matching the causal fingerprint of the recovered complete events against the expected uninterrupted stream.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
